I looked at these five images only.

## Verdict: accepted for the fixed channel defects in the depicted states

**Compared with the Concept C reference (shared hierarchy, theme and controls only):**
- **Hierarchy:** At 390, 768 and 1366 the page goes in this order: back control, large title, metadata line, jump links, then section cards. That matches the reference's title, subtitle, controls and content order. The layout is RTL right-anchored with Cairo, and there is no horizontal overflow at any width.
- **Theme:** Neutral warm-grey canvas, white rounded cards with a soft border, teal-green brand and active-nav accent. This is consistent with the reference.
- **Repaired defects are visible:**
  - **Inset cards:** The outer section cards are inset from the viewport edge, and the record and version cards are inset inside them. This holds at all three widths.
  - **Summary controls:** "تعديل سياسة القناة" and "إيقاف القناة" are outlined controls with a down chevron.
  - **Danger styling:** "إيقاف القناة" uses a red tinted fill, border and text, separate from the neutral controls.
- **768 capture:** Full width and full content, so it validly replaces the earlier cropped 768 capture.
- **Existing deviations, not new:** Cairo; radius-8 controls; 44px mobile / 40px desktop targets; 900 breakpoint, so 390 and 768 use bottom nav and 1366 uses the dark sidebar baseline; channel pages read from the source of truth rather than a new inbox.

## Blockers in these depicted states
None found. No false success, hidden necessary action, unexplained disabled action or context loss is visible. The back control, both jump links, "فتح الحركة" and both disclosures are visible and labelled at every width.

Non-blocking notes:
- At 390 and 768 the Next.js dev badge ("N") partly covers the "المزيد" bottom-nav item. This is a dev-overlay artifact in the captures, not product UI.
- The images show only closed disclosures with no focus state. The open chevron, visible focus ring and Enter open/close/stop behaviour can't be confirmed from these images. They rest on your separate runtime PASS.

## Recording
Yes, you can record the bounded runtime evidence as a channel-scoped CSS receipt for the eight rules. It does not close any wider stage or gate.

## Exclusions (still open)
Full R0–R8 (including R1/R4/R5), geofence/device, financial, concurrency, import, all roles, the other visual states (dark, open, focus, error, empty, loading) and semantic/a11y coverage; no speed improvement or before-redesign N/C/P/I/B comparison is claimed.
